root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: The `p` used by `vips_error( class->nickname, _( "bad number \"%s\"" ), p )` must not be the token pointer already invalidated by the immediately preceding `g_free( line )`.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `vips_foreign_load_matrix_load()` formats the bad-number message, the `%s` argument `p` must still refer to live row-buffer storage; the error path must not free `line` while `p` still aliases that row buffer.
root_cause_criterion.description: In the vulnerable error branch, `g_free( line )` runs first and the same token pointer `p` is then passed to `vips_error(...)`, so the formatter receives a dangling `%s` argument. In the fixed program, the same error call executes before the row buffer is freed, so the `%s` argument is live when formatting begins.

nodes.state: `vips_buf_vappendf()` reaches the AddressSanitizer-reported `vips_vsnprintf()` call with the bad-number `%s` string argument still present in `ap`, so formatting dereferences that token pointer at the sink.

edges.via: p -> the first `%s` vararg in ap
edges.relation: The same token pointer passed as `p` to `vips_error( ..., p )` is forwarded through `vips_verror()` into `vips_buf_vappendf()` as the first `%s` string argument that `vips_vsnprintf()` dereferences.
